verdict.rationale: SCIM docs confirm Okta can push user CRUD (including deactivation) operations to connected apps via provisioning, and event hooks could trigger downstream deprovisioning workflows, supporting the general lifecycle-management capability. However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents that a single deactivate action immediately terminates active sessions and deprovisions all connected apps in one step. Missing for 10: explicit docs/screenshots of the 'deactivate user' action revoking sessions instantly, and confirmation that SCIM push is synchronous/immediate across all connected apps rather than eventual/webhook-driven.
